name.zh: 3 号联邦公路（特卡特—恩塞纳达—埃尔奇内罗）

aka.en: Carretera Tecate–El Sauzal; La Ruta del Vino (the wine road through the Valle de Guadalupe)
aka.zh: 特卡特—埃尔绍萨尔公路；“葡萄酒之路”（穿越瓜达卢佩谷）
恩塞纳达—圣费利佩公路（恩塞纳达—埃尔奇内罗）

tagline.en: Two free roads in northern Baja California: one from the Tecate border crossing through Mexico's wine valleys to the Pacific, the other from Ensenada over the Sierra Juárez to the Gulf of California road near San Felipe
tagline.zh: 下加利福尼亚北部的两段免费公路：一段从特卡特口岸穿过墨西哥葡萄酒产区直抵太平洋，另一段从恩塞纳达越过华雷斯山脉，接上圣费利佩附近的加利福尼亚湾沿岸公路

start.en: Tecate, Baja California, at the border crossing with California State Route 188 and the junction with Federal Highway 2
start.zh: 下加利福尼亚州特卡特，与加利福尼亚州 188 号公路相接的边境口岸，及与 2 号联邦公路的交会处

end.en: El Chinero, on Federal Highway 5 about 55 km north of San Felipe
end.zh: 埃尔奇内罗，位于 5 号联邦公路上、圣费利佩以北约 55 公里

en: Federal Highway 3 is in two pieces. The first runs south-west from the border at Tecate through the Valle de las Palmas, the Valle de Guadalupe and San Antonio de las Minas, and drops to the Pacific at El Sauzal, just north of Ensenada, where it meets Highway 1. English Wikipedia gives it as 112 km. By linking Highway 2 to Ensenada it lets traffic from the mainland reach the peninsula's Pacific coast without passing through Tijuana.

The second piece leaves Ensenada eastwards, climbs through the Ojos Negros and Valle de la Trinidad basins, crosses the Sierra Juárez and comes down to the desert at El Chinero, on Highway 5 north of San Felipe; English Wikipedia gives 196 km, and the ministry's 2016 traffic stations run to kilometre 196 at El Chinero. Spanish Wikipedia gives a total of 304 km. A military checkpoint stands just south of the El Chinero junction.

The first piece is the spine of Mexico's main wine region. The valleys it crosses were mission country: the Dominicans founded their last mission in Baja California, Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe del Norte, in the Valle de Guadalupe in 1834. The state tourism ministry began promoting the area as the Ruta del Vino in 2004, with a first guide listing 16 wineries; by 2015 its guide listed 89.
zh: 3 号联邦公路分为两段。第一段自特卡特边境向西南，穿过拉斯帕尔马斯谷、瓜达卢佩谷和圣安东尼奥德拉斯米纳斯，在恩塞纳达以北的埃尔绍萨尔下到太平洋岸边，与 1 号公路相接。英语维基百科给出其长度为 112 公里。它把 2 号公路与恩塞纳达连起来，使来自大陆的车辆不必经过蒂华纳即可抵达半岛的太平洋沿岸。
第二段自恩塞纳达向东，爬升穿过奥霍斯内格罗斯和特立尼达谷两处盆地，越过华雷斯山脉，下到圣费利佩以北 5 号公路上的埃尔奇内罗沙漠；英语维基百科给出 196 公里，交通部 2016 年的交通观测站也一直排到埃尔奇内罗的 196 公里处。西班牙语维基百科给出的总长为 304 公里。埃尔奇内罗路口以南不远处设有军方检查站。
第一段是墨西哥主要葡萄酒产区的主干道。沿途谷地曾是传教区：多明我会于 1834 年在瓜达卢佩谷建立了他们在下加利福尼亚的最后一座传教站——北方瓜达卢佩圣母传教站。州旅游厅于 2004 年开始以“葡萄酒之路”推广这一地区，第一份指南列出 16 家酒庄；到 2015 年，其指南已列出 89 家。

en: The eastern piece follows an old line. In 1794 José Joaquín de Arrillaga, lieutenant governor of the Californias, began using San Felipe as a port and established the overland route from there to Ensenada by way of the Valle de la Trinidad. Spanish Wikipedia dates the start of the modern road to 1943, under Rodolfo Sánchez Taboada, governor of the Northern Territory of Baja California.

By 2009, when the transport ministry filed plans to widen it, the Tecate–Ensenada road had been in service for more than thirty years as a two-lane road 7 m wide, and its traffic had outgrown that design. The plan widened 90 km between Tecate and San Antonio de las Minas to 12 m and straightened curves at several points; the environmental statement estimated the cost at about 161 million pesos.

The work as built covered 77.1 km. President Enrique Peña Nieto and Governor Francisco Vega de Lamadrid opened it on 11 June 2018: the road had been widened from 7 to 12 m, with two 3.5 m lanes and 2.5 m shoulders, seven bridges and a junction, and more than seventy curves straightened, cutting 12 km from the route. The federal government put the cost at 1,147 million pesos, against the 161 million estimated in 2009. At the southern end, the Baja California government began rebuilding the El Sauzal junction with Highway 1 in 2023, at a cost of 240 million pesos; the state's infrastructure secretary said the interchange was more than forty years old and well past its capacity.
zh: 东段沿着一条古道。1794 年，加利福尼亚副总督何塞·华金·德阿里亚加开始把圣费利佩用作港口，并开辟了经特立尼达谷通往恩塞纳达的陆路。西班牙语维基百科把现代公路的动工定在 1943 年，时任下加利福尼亚北部领地总督为罗多尔福·桑切斯·塔沃阿达。
到 2009 年交通部提交拓宽方案时，特卡特—恩塞纳达公路已作为 7 米宽的双车道公路使用了三十多年，交通量已超出原设计能力。方案将特卡特至圣安东尼奥德拉斯米纳斯之间的 90 公里拓宽至 12 米，并在若干处裁弯取直；环境影响报告估算造价约 1.61 亿比索。

实际建成的工程长 77.1 公里。2018 年 6 月 11 日，恩里克·培尼亚·涅托总统与州长弗朗西斯科·维加·德拉马德里主持通车：路面由 7 米拓宽至 12 米，设两条 3.5 米车道和 2.5 米路肩，建有七座桥梁和一处路口，裁直七十多处弯道，线路缩短 12 公里。联邦政府公布的造价为 11.47 亿比索，而 2009 年的估算为 1.61 亿比索。在南端，下加利福尼亚州政府于 2023 年开始改建与 1 号公路相接的埃尔绍萨尔立交，投资 2.4 亿比索；州基础设施厅长称这座立交已有四十多年历史，早已超出其通行能力。

en: Both pieces are maintained under the ministry's national conservation programme. In 2025 it resurfaced kilometres 94 to 101.5 of Tecate–El Sauzal, both carriageways, for about 35 million pesos, and patched seven kilometres of Ensenada–El Chinero for 16.2 million; in 2026 it allotted 33.3 million pesos to mill and resurface kilometres 10 to 20.55 of Ensenada–El Chinero.
zh: 两段公路均纳入交通部全国公路养护计划。2025 年，该部以约 3,500 万比索重铺特卡特—埃尔绍萨尔公路 94 至 101.5 公里处的双向路面，并以 1,620 万比索修补恩塞纳达—埃尔奇内罗公路七公里；2026 年又拨款 3,330 万比索，对恩塞纳达—埃尔奇内罗公路 10 至 20.55 公里处进行铣刨重铺。

value.en: 112 km Tecate–El Sauzal and 196 km Ensenada–El Chinero (English Wikipedia); Spanish Wikipedia gives 304 km in all
value.zh: 特卡特—埃尔绍萨尔 112 公里，恩塞纳达—埃尔奇内罗 196 公里（英语维基百科）；西班牙语维基百科给出总长 304 公里

figures.source: English Wikipedia, Mexican Federal Highway 3; Spanish Wikipedia, Carretera Federal 3; SCT, Datos Viales 2017, Baja California

why.en: No public figure for the original roads; the cost of the 2018 modernisation of Tecate–San Antonio de las Minas is given below.
why.zh: 原有公路无公开造价；2018 年特卡特—圣安东尼奥德拉斯米纳斯段改造的造价见下文。

label.en: Tecate–San Antonio de las Minas modernisation
label.zh: 特卡特—圣安东尼奥德拉斯米纳斯段改造

value.en: 1,147 million pesos (federal) for 77.1 km widened from 7 to 12 m, with seven bridges; opened 11 June 2018. The ministry's own close-out report gives 1,141.3 million. The 2009 environmental statement had estimated about 161 million.
value.zh: 联邦出资 11.47 亿比索，将 77.1 公里路面由 7 米拓宽至 12 米，建七座桥梁；2018 年 6 月 11 日通车。交通部自己的总结报告给出 11.413 亿比索。2009 年环境影响报告曾估算约 1.61 亿比索。

figures.source: Tijuana en la Noticia and PoderMX, 11–12 June 2018; SCT, Dirección General de Carreteras, memoria documental; SEMARNAT, MIA-R 02BC2009V0003

value.en: Federal, through the transport ministry, for the road and its upkeep; the El Sauzal junction rebuilding of 2023 was a Baja California state work of 240 million pesos.
value.zh: 公路及其养护由联邦交通部出资；2023 年埃尔绍萨尔立交改建为下加利福尼亚州政府工程，投资 2.4 亿比索。

figures.source: SCT, Dirección General de Carreteras, memoria documental; El Imparcial, 7 September 2023

value.en: 33.3 million pesos to mill and resurface km 10–20.55 of Ensenada–El Chinero
value.zh: 3,330 万比索，铣刨重铺恩塞纳达—埃尔奇内罗公路 10 至 20.55 公里

figures.source: SICT, Dirección General de Conservación de Carreteras, Programa Nacional de Conservación de Carreteras, Baja California, July 2026

timeline.en: José Joaquín de Arrillaga opens the overland route from San Felipe to Ensenada through the Valle de la Trinidad.
timeline.zh: 何塞·华金·德阿里亚加开辟经特立尼达谷从圣费利佩到恩塞纳达的陆路。

timeline.en: The Dominicans found their last Baja California mission in the Valle de Guadalupe.
timeline.zh: 多明我会在瓜达卢佩谷建立其在下加利福尼亚的最后一座传教站。

timeline.en: Construction of the modern road begins under Rodolfo Sánchez Taboada, by Spanish Wikipedia's account.
timeline.zh: 据西班牙语维基百科，现代公路在罗多尔福·桑切斯·塔沃阿达任内动工。

timeline.en: The state tourism ministry launches the Ruta del Vino with a first guide of 16 wineries.
timeline.zh: 州旅游厅推出“葡萄酒之路”，第一份指南列出 16 家酒庄。

timeline.en: The transport ministry files plans to widen 90 km from Tecate to San Antonio de las Minas.
timeline.zh: 交通部提交特卡特至圣安东尼奥德拉斯米纳斯 90 公里拓宽方案。

timeline.en: Enrique Peña Nieto opens the widened Tecate–San Antonio de las Minas road on 11 June.
timeline.zh: 6 月 11 日，恩里克·培尼亚·涅托为拓宽后的特卡特—圣安东尼奥德拉斯米纳斯公路主持通车。

timeline.en: The state begins rebuilding the El Sauzal junction with Highway 1.
timeline.zh: 州政府开始改建与 1 号公路相接的埃尔绍萨尔立交。

timeline.en: The ministry resurfaces kilometres 10 to 20.55 of Ensenada–El Chinero.
timeline.zh: 交通部重铺恩塞纳达—埃尔奇内罗公路 10 至 20.55 公里路段。
